comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1209 clips a PCB lead and contains the offcut.
comparison.physical_skill: Concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque plus retained-angle testing differs from bimanual nipper cutting and offcut capture.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° setting retained over three cycles; PR-1209 requires a flush cut without free flight and disposal of the offcut.
comparison.reason: The shared bimanual tool use is generic; the manipulated mechanisms and tested outcomes are different.
